overview: Tonga is an island country in the South Pacific and the only kingdom among the Pacific island nations. Its capital, Nuku'alofa, is on the main island of Tongatapu. Tonga was never colonised, although it was a British protected state until 1970. It has about 170 islands, fewer than 40 of which are lived on.

geography.text: Tonga's islands are a mix of low coral islands and higher volcanic ones. Underwater volcanoes are active nearby: in 2022 the eruption of Hunga Tonga–Hunga Ha'apai was one of the most powerful volcanic eruptions in recent history and sent a tsunami across the Pacific.
